source_excerpt:
Coal India PM Internship Recruitment 2026: Coal India Limited (CIL), a Maharatna Government of India undertaking, has released an engagement notice dated 30 October 2026 for 50 internship opportunities under the Prime Minister Internship Scheme (PMIS). The internships include Office Intern - Secretarial Practice, Office Intern - COPA and Office Assistant - Steno Hindi positions at CIL Headquarters, Kolkata, and North Eastern Coalfields, Margherita, Assam. Candidates with ITI, Diploma, Graduation, Postgraduation or Class 12 qualifications can apply, subject to PMIS eligibility conditions. Online applications open on 2 November 2026 and close on 2 December 2026 through pminternship.mca.gov.in .
Coal India PM Internship Recruitment 2026 - Overview
Important: Coal India has announced internship opportunities under PMIS, not permanent employment positions. Candidates must satisfy the scheme's eligibility requirements and apply through the PMIS portal only.
Coal India PM Internship Recruitment 2026 Important Dates
The notice does not specify the closing time on 2 December 2026. Candidates should confirm the submission deadline and any subsequent updates on the PMIS portal.
Coal India PM Internship Opportunities 2026
Coal India has announced 50 internship opportunities across five PMIS listings . Of these, 30 are located at CIL Headquarters in Kolkata and 20 at North Eastern Coalfields in Margherita, Assam.
Coal India Internship-Wise Opportunity Details
Coal India Internship Location-Wise Opportunities
All five listings are described as Regular internships. Candidates should use the exact Internship ID to identify the relevant opportunity on the PMIS portal.
Coal India PM Internship Recruitment 2026 Notification PDF
Coal India Limited has issued an official engagement notice dated 30 October 2026 for 50 internship opportunities under the Prime Minister Internship Scheme.
The notice includes the five internship IDs, position titles, locations, opportunity counts, qualification preference order and application dates.
Official Company Website: Coal India Limited
PMIS Application Portal: Prime Minister Internship Scheme
Coal India PM Internship Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
Candidates with ITI, Diploma, Graduation, Postgraduation or Class 12 qualifications can apply for the notified internships, subject to the eligibility requirements under PMIS.
Important Qualification Rule: Although Class 12 candidates are eligible, they receive preference after ITI, Diploma, Graduate and Postgraduate applicants. The next qualification category will be considered only after eligible candidates in the preceding category have been exhausted.
The notice lists Class 12 as the minimum qualification for the five internships and does not prescribe a specific course restriction in its opportunity table. However, applicants must follow the detailed eligibility displayed for the selected Internship ID on the PMIS portal.
The Coal India engagement notice does not specify a separate age limit for these 50 internship opportunities.
Candidates must satisfy the age and other eligibility conditions applicable to the Prime Minister Internship Scheme at the time of application. Applicants should check the current PMIS guidelines and their chosen internship listing before applying.
The Coal India notice does not mention a fixed monthly stipend, training allowance or internship duration for the advertised opportunities.
Candidates should check the applicable stipend, benefits, attendance requirements and engagement duration in the relevant PMIS portal listing.
The engagement should not be treated as a permanent Coal India appointment or a regular government salary position.
Coal India PM Internship Application Fee 2026
The engagement notice does not mention any application fee or separate fee payment procedure.
Applicants should follow the instructions on the official PMIS portal and should not make payments through unofficial websites or intermediaries.
Coal India PM Internship Selection Process 2026
Coal India has specified a qualification-priority and marks-based selection preference for the 50 internship opportunities.
How Preference Works: ITI candidates will be considered first. Within the ITI category, applicants with higher marks will receive preference. Diploma candidates will be considered only after candidates in the ITI category have been exhausted. The same method applies successively to Graduate, Postgraduate and Class 12 applicants.
The notice does not prescribe a separate written examination or interview. Any additional screening or onboarding requirements must be checked against the PMIS portal instructions.
Coal India PM Internship Apply Online 2026
Eligible candidates can apply through the official Prime Minister Internship Scheme portal from 2 November to 2 December 2026 .
Apply Online: Coal India PMIS Internship Application Portal
Applicants should search for the Coal India internship listings using the relevant Internship IDs and check the detailed requirements before submitting their applications.
How to Apply Online for Coal India PM Internship Recruitment 2026?
Visit the official Prime Minister Internship Scheme portal at pminternship.mca.gov.in/login/ .
Sign in or complete the candidate registration process as instructed by the PMIS portal.
Read the current PMIS eligibility criteria and application instructions.
Search for internship opportunities offered by Coal India Limited.
Identify the required position using the corresponding Internship ID.
Choose the applicable location: CIL Headquarters, Kolkata, or North Eastern Coalfields, Margherita.
Review the internship description, qualifications, benefits and other conditions displayed on the portal.
Enter the required personal, educational and contact details.
Provide qualification details and marks accurately, as selection preference depends on the qualification level and marks.
Complete any additional information or document requirements shown on the application portal.
Review all application details before submission.
Submit the application online by 2 December 2026 .
Retain the application acknowledgement or confirmation available through the portal.
Important: Coal India will consider only applications submitted through the official PMIS portal. Applications sent through email, post or other channels are not accepted under this notice.
Documents Required for Coal India PM Internship 2026
The Coal India engagement notice does not provide a separate document-upload checklist. Applicants should keep the following documents or information ready, subject to the requirements displayed on the PMIS portal.
Proof of educational qualification, such as Class 12, ITI, Diploma, Graduation or Postgraduation certificates, as applicable.
Relevant marksheets for the qualification claimed.
Valid identification and date-of-birth proof, as required by the portal.
Any additional documents required for the selected PMIS internship.
Applicants should upload only the documents requested by the portal and ensure that the information entered matches their supporting records.
Coal India Limited has announced 30 internship opportunities at its headquarters in Kolkata, West Bengal, across Secretarial Practice, COPA and Steno Hindi roles.
North Eastern Coalfields - Margherita, Assam
The North Eastern Coalfields location at Margherita, Assam, has 20 internship opportunities for Office Intern - Secretarial Practice and Office Intern - COPA.
Coal India PM Internship 2026 Important Instructions
The engagement notice covers 50 internship opportunities under PMIS.
Online applications open on 2 November 2026.
The application closing date is 2 December 2026.
Applications must be submitted through the official PMIS portal only.
Eligible qualifications include ITI, Diploma, Graduation, Postgraduation and Class 12.
Selection preference is given in the order ITI, Diploma, Graduate, Postgraduate and Class 12.
Higher marks receive preference within the same qualification category.
The next qualification category is considered only after the preceding category has been exhausted.
Applicants should use the correct Internship ID when selecting an opportunity.
Age, stipend, internship duration and benefit details should be checked on the PMIS portal.
Internship engagement must not be confused with permanent government employment.
